summary: Each published node's actions now come from the debug_a11y_tree_json() on_action list, mapped onto the bridge's NodeAction vocabulary with the patched bridge's rule; dispatch stays native through Window::on_a11y_action and GPUI's built-in Click/Focus fallback, and the bridge registers no listeners because a matching listener suppresses that fallback. observer.rs carries zero diagnostics under cargo check -p gpui-mcp --tests.

tests.command: cargo check -p gpui-mcp --tests — scoped: zero diagnostics in crates/gpui-mcp/src/observer.rs; remaining errors are the four known Batch B integration points (input.rs:143/147, service.rs:601, lib.rs:71)
Select-String observer.rs for '#[ignore = ' — both gpui integration tests carry the Batch C C02 reason and are compiled but not run

observer.rs action anchors: on_action parsed from aria, actions_from_names with ReplaceSelectedText/SetValue/SCROLL_ACTION_NAMES, tests assert the fixture's five advertised actions map to [Click, Focus, SetText, SetValue, Scroll]

B02-ACTION-MAPPING.evidence: Every published node's actions are derived from its aria.on_action list with the patched bridge's rule: Click; Focus; SetText when ReplaceSelectedText is advertised or the role is editable and SetValue is; SetValue; Scroll when any of the seven scroll actions is advertised (deduplicated in that order). Dispatch is native and untouched: the platform accessibility adapter is the only ActionRequest source (gpui-pre window.rs:1626), requests reach listeners registered through Window::on_a11y_action (window.rs:6791), and GPUI's built-in fallback clicks a Clicked node at its bounds center and focuses a Focused node (window.rs:6805). The bridge registers no listeners of its own because handle_a11y_action skips that built-in fallback whenever any listener matches, so a bridge listener would silently disable native click and focus dispatch.

risks: The dispatch half of the acceptance is satisfied natively rather than by bridge code: GPUI exposes no public API to send an ActionRequest, so the bridge cannot drive actions through on_a11y_action, and registering a listener would set `matched` and suppress GPUI's built-in Click/Focus handling.

Hover and Drag can no longer be reported: the patch inferred them from GPUI interactivity, and AccessKit has no corresponding actions, so only Click, Focus, SetText, SetValue, and Scroll are reportable.

Correction to T02's report: the two gpui integration tests in observer.rs cannot run — stock GPUI builds the tree only after a platform adapter activates it (C02), the test platform provides no adapter, and debug_a11y_tree_json() therefore returns None in tests. Both are now #[ignore]d with that reason; the runtime proof remains D02's.
The parser test cannot execute until the crate links (B05): observer.rs is verified by the scoped cargo check --tests run (zero diagnostics), not by execution.
